terms._note: Summary of the Terms & Conditions page on the old site. Have the owner confirm before publishing.
terms.deposits: Within 7 days of confirming a booking, a suitable deposit (by agreement or as set out in the itinerary) is required on all long-distance charters and tours. Day trips don't normally need a deposit unless we must pay one to hold entertainment or services.
terms.localChartersAndTours: Full payment on the day for charters; payment in full before departure for tours that include meals, entertainment, entry fees or services.
terms.longDistance: Charters: full payment 7 days before departure. Tours including accommodation, meals, entertainment and entry: paid in full at least 21 days before departure.
terms.refunds: At management's discretion. Cancellation or full travel insurance is strongly recommended. Money paid to third parties on your behalf is subject to their policies. Health-related cancellations need a doctor's certificate. Where practical, we'll let you take the same tour later at the same price or credit the fare to another tour.

dayTours.title: Day tours
body: Our day tours usually stay within about 120 km of Adelaide so the pace stays leisurely, but they can go as far as 250 km. We have an extensive list of popular day tours and ideas, or we can tailor one to your group.

A day tour normally runs from around 8 or 8.30am until 5 or 5.30pm, and we can make it shorter or longer to suit you. We usually price it as a package for your group's numbers, including meals, attractions or entertainment along with the coach. Prefer just the sightseeing? We can do that too, with lunch and activities at your own expense.
A complimentary morning tea can be served from the coach.

mystery.title: Mystery trips
mystery.body: The destination is kept secret until you're there, and it's somewhere different every time. Set up for budget touring: you pay for the coach, morning tea is on us, and we always stop where lunch can be bought — or bring your own.

shortBreaks.title: Short breaks
body: Quick trips of 2 or 3 days go up to 400 km from Adelaide, with overnight accommodation, breakfasts, evening meals and daily morning tea. We take a different road home so you see as much as possible.

3–6 day tours go up to 750 km and mostly stay at the same motel each night. They're packaged with commentary, most morning teas, entry fees, accommodation and meals — and we avoid travelling the same road twice.

extended.title: Extended holidays
body: These tours can go anywhere in Australia, with everything in the itinerary included. Because of the distances, some nights are one-night stays, but we build in 2–4 night stays so you get a break from moving.

snow.title: Snow trips
snow.body: From a weekend in the snowfields to a full 5–7 day ski holiday. Our drivers hold hazard licences for the Victorian and NSW alpine areas.

seniors.heading: Seniors & special-interest groups
seniors.body: We tailor tours to your group: venues to suit you, a comfortable pace and a price that fits your budget. We're happy to come to your club or senior citizens' meeting to talk about trip options.
points: A price suited to your budget

express.heading: Express long-distance runs
body: When a group needs to cover a long distance quickly and safely, we run it as an express trip. For journeys over 12 hours, two drivers share the wheel, with a regulation sleeper bunk at the back of the coach so one can rest while the other drives.

Coaches are limited to 100 km/h on the open road. With short breaks every 3–4 hours we average about 80 km an hour, so a 1,500 km trip — Adelaide to Sydney or Alice Springs — takes under 20 hours, depending on traffic and weather.
Overnight driving means watching for wildlife and wandering stock, so our drivers stay rested and alert while you sleep. The on-board rest room means fewer stops.

drivers.heading: Our drivers
body: Our professional drivers are knowledgeable, informative and easy to get along with. They hold high standards and know the roads and regulations well above average.
They hold hazard licences for the Victorian and NSW alpine areas and have hands-on experience with outback conditions and dirt roads in all weather — and they're always ready to join in the fun.
